ambient_events: The bed's black silk catches the light and lets it go reluctantly.
The wall screen shifts through a muted feed, painting the room in slow colour.
Something expensive and floral hangs in the air, just short of cloying.
description: The owner's private suite — Cyd's quarters. A low black-silk bed the size of a small room, a bar stocked with things that don't exist on any menu, and a wall of screen that can show anything the vessel can reach. Every surface is soft, dark, and worth a fortune. This is the still center of the Echelon, and it answers to exactly one person. The only way out is the hatch (SOUTH) to the landing.
name: Echelon — Owner's Suite
